verdict.rationale: React's component composition model (react-gh-1, react-docs-1/3) supports scalable UI architecture, and docs point to full-stack frameworks like Next.js for building entire large apps (react-docs-4), plus server rendering/streaming for performance (react-docs-6, react-docs-7). However, community evidence shows real complexity/performance trade-offs (concurrent mode 'kludgy hacks', hard-to-understand internals) requiring extra tooling and expertise to scale well (react-comm-5, react-comm-6, react-comm-7).
